methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 distinct, independently verified electric waffle-maker models spanning Belgian and classic plate formats, from budget mini units to premium multi-program appliances. Specs re-verified against manufacturer product pages (breville.com, hamiltonbeach.com, all-clad.com, gopresto.com, krupsusa.com, chefman.com, blackanddecker.com, bydash.com) and major retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy, Home Depot, Target). Several manufacturer product pages (cuisinart.com, blackanddecker.com direct model URLs) return 404/blank to automated fetchers, so for those the most reliable retailer/topical source was used as source.url. priceUsd reflects the published US MSRP or manufacturer-site price for the EXACT named model/config; null wattage = not disclosed on any verified manufacturer/retailer spec page (a null beats a guess). boolean specs: true=feature confirmed present, false=confirmed absent; null=not disclosed. accessedAt 2026-06-20. Corrections from the draft: Breville BWM640XL releaseDate 2014->2013; several source/corroboration URLs replaced with working topical pages; low-authority review aggregator (shouldit.com) dropped as corroboration. No products were fabricated; all 11 exist and were retained.

Home Depot / Walmart / Kohl's / BrandsMart / Everything Kitchens / Abt / CamelCamelCamel all returned 403/robot-check.
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-07-10 by re-fetching both URLs. Cuisinart's own pages (WMR-CANAS.html and the /shopping/ and /discontinued/ WMR-CA URLs) all 404 or redirect to a blank PX-Show for automated fetchers, so source.url points to the canonical exact-model Amazon listing (B00006JKZN, part #WMR-CAP2), which fetched successfully and confirmed: bakes 1 large traditional-style waffle, 5-setting browning control, red/green "ready to bake/ready to eat" indicator lights, and nonstick coating. Amazon and Kitchen Kapers (WMR-CANAS) are the same Round Classic Waffle Maker (base WMR-CA) — same specs, different pack SKUs — not a sibling/different-capacity model, so model identity is correct. Kitchen Kapers (corroboration, fetched) confirmed the same specs — one large traditional-style waffle in nonstick baking plates, five-setting browning control, red/green ready-to-bake/ready-to-eat indicator lights — and supplied the only verbatim USD price ($49.95 current, $57.00 original). On adversarial re-verification, flip_rotating and removable_plates were nulled: neither fetched page explicitly states the unit does not flip/rotate or that its plates are non-removable, so the false values could not be verbatim-confirmed. Surviving verbatim-supported specs: plate_type (Round Classic / traditional-style), plate_count (bakes one large waffle), browning_control_levels (five-setting / "Number of settings 5"), nonstick_plates (Non Stick Coating / nonstick baking plates), indicator_lights. wattage_w remains null because the Amazon page conflicts internally (title 1250W vs spec table 1500 watts). priceUsd $49.95 is verbatim from the Kitchen Kapers corroboration; the Amazon page rendered EUR only due to geo-detection.

products.name: Breville the No-Mess Waffle
products.priceNote: MSRP $169.95 per breville.com product page (listed price "$169.95 / Add to cart")
products.provenance: Adversarially re-verified by re-fetching both pages. Breville manufacturer page confirms the exact model "the No-mess Waffle" (BWM520): price "$169.95" ("Add to cart - $169.95"), a "Classic circular waffle maker", browning control "With 7 settings", the "No mess moat", PFOA-free non-stick coating on Die-Cast Aluminum Cooking Plates, and a "Ready light" that "illuminates when it's ready". Wattage is NOT disclosed on the Breville page, so it was taken from the corroborating retailer. The Amazon listing (ASIN B00M2OI2NY, Part Number 603119-BWM520XL, "Breville BWM520XL No-Mess Classic Round Waffle Maker") confirms the exact BWM520XL model and states Wattage 900 watts (Power: 900 Watts; Voltage 110-120 V), "Browning control dial with 7 color settings" ("Number of settings 7"), PFOA-free non-stick coating, and "Capacity: 1 Classic waffle (approx. 6-5/8\" x 5-5/8\")". flip_rotating=false is supported by an Amazon verified-purchase review ("No having to flip it") and the stationary circular-moat design. removable_plates kept null: no manufacturer spec states removable/fixed status (several Amazon customer reviews mention "the plates are not removable", but that is user-generated, not an official spec, so it was not adopted as a value). releaseDate is not published on either page so it was kept null. Walmart's listing hit a bot-challenge wall and was not used.

products.provenance: Verified against a fresh fetch of both pages. Exact model confirmed: Amazon spec/product-info block lists "Part Number RJ04-4RV" (ASIN B071L9H1CQ) and Newegg lists "Model RJ04-4RV" — both match the slug (not the sibling RJ04-AO-4). Chefman's own site has no live product page for the discontinued RJ04-4RV, so source.url is the canonical Amazon listing for the exact model and corroboration is the Newegg listing, following the catalog's established precedent (cuisinart-waf-300p1). Amazon's spec table confirms verbatim: "Belgian Waffle Maker", "Wattage 700 watts", "Voltage 120 Volts", "Number of settings 1" (no browning dial), "Material Nonstick", plus "700 Watts/120 Volts" in the description; reviews confirm an indicator light ("the ready light on mine is inconsistent"), non-removable plates ("plates aren't removable" / "The plates don't come off"), and no browning/crispiness adjustment ("does not come with a timer or adjustment to make for the crispiness"). Newegg independently confirms Model RJ04-4RV, Type Waffle Maker, Belgian, "Nonstick Interior Yes", and "First Listed on Newegg July 11, 2017" — consistent with the "2017 Global Innovation Award" cited on the Amazon page, supporting releaseDate 2017. flip_rotating=false is supported by the stationary pour/volcano operation described on both pages (twist spout, pour, cook) with no flip/rotate mechanism. No US price appeared on any fetched page (Amazon "No featured offers available" / "Currently unavailable"; Newegg "Out of stock"; Amazon prices shown were EUR due to a Germany locale), so priceUsd is left null. All eight spec keys survive verification.

Exact model confirmed: Amazon title "Oster 2110002 DiamondForce Vertical Waffle Maker" with Part Number 2110002 / UPC 053891138208, and WoodArtSupply repeating Part Number 2110002, model number 2110002, EAN 0053891138208 — same unit, not a sibling/variant. WoodArtSupply corroborated the same unit via matching UPC/EAN and a live USD price of $37.87. wattage_w=700, nonstick_plates=true, indicator_lights=true are all verbatim-supported; flip_rotating=false and removable_plates=false are supported as conservative negatives (vertical upright, "no turning"; no removable-plate feature mentioned). plate_type is null (neither fetched page states "Belgian"/"classic"; only customer-review text says "Belgian"). browning_control_levels is null (no browning dial; Amazon "Number of settings: 1" and reviewers say "No temp control"). plate_count was nulled on this pass: no fetched page states any plate or simultaneous-waffle count verbatim — "Number of settings 1" refers to browning, not plates. releaseDate left null: the only date found (WoodArtSupply auto-generated "Release Date: 01-09-2020") is a low-authority, ambiguously-formatted field not confirmed by the manufacturer or a major retailer.
